verdict.rationale: Neon ships a well-documented official CLI (`neon`) covering project/branch management, AI-agent setup (`init`, `mcp`, `skills`, `plugins`, `ask`, `claim`, `api-keys`), with unattended/agent flags (`-y --agent`) explicitly for AI-native workflows, and this was independently verified by a keyless runtime probe (`npx -y neon@latest --version`) confirming it works without an account. Missing for 10: no independent third-party (non-vendor) review of CLI usability/agenticness beyond the single runtime probe.
